plain: To push forward or force in where unwanted

webster.text: To thrust in or on; to throw, crowd or thrust into any place or state by force or imposition, or without solicitation.

example.quote: And it often happens when advice is wanted, the worst men, the most interested creatures, the worst advice is at hand, obtrude themselves, and misdirect the mind of him who would be informed and advised.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XIII, Jan. 14, 1788
